Hi Simon —

Thanks for sending this over and for filling the form. Welcome! Short answers below and a consolidated checklist attached.

1) VAT docs: please upload your VAT registration certificate (VAT registration page or HMRC confirmation) and a copy of a company registration extract (Companies House). We need both for UK suppliers so AP can validate VAT handling.

2) Invoicing and currency: we can accept GBP invoices. Our standard PO will be issued in the currency agreed on the quote (for this opportunity it will be GBP). Please include your bank details on the invoice exactly as in your form (beneficiary name, IBAN, SWIFT/BIC). For GBP local transfers sometimes we require sort code + account number instead of IBAN — the invoice/bank stub should include both where applicable.

3) US tax forms / residency: because you are a UK entity, you do NOT submit a W-9. Instead, if there is US source income or withholding risk we may request a W-8BEN-E. For typical services provided to our EU entity there is no US withholding.

4) VAT treatment at Redwood: for UK suppliers that invoice Redwood UK Ltd with UK VAT we will process VAT as charged. If your supply falls under reverse-charge (e.g., B2B services where Redwood accounts for VAT), we will notify you and instruct the PO to be tax-exclusive. For now, please invoice with VAT where applicable and include VAT registration number on the invoice.

Next steps for upload:
- Please return the completed vendor form + VAT cert + Companies House extract.
- Upload documents to our supplier portal (link below) OR email to procurement@redwood.com if portal access is an issue.

I attached our onboarding checklist to make it easier. I cc'd Monica (procurement) who will create the supplier record and route the first PO.

Thanks again — we should have the supplier record created within 48 hours of receiving the docs.

Best,
Lauren Bishop

Thanks — confirmed from finance side. A couple points to be explicit so AP can process first invoice/PO without delay:

- Tax withholding: No US withholding applies for payments to UK corporate suppliers for services rendered to our UK/EU entities. If Redwood US pays and there is US source income, we will review; for this opportunity we will pay from Redwood UK and handle VAT accordingly.

- PO setup: Create PO tied to Redwood UK legal entity, set currency = GBP, set tax handling = "VAT charged by supplier" unless Acme confirms reverse-charge. If Acme confirms reverse-charge, mark PO tax code RC and include note: "Reverse charge: recipient to account for VAT under UK VAT law."

- Bank verification: AP will need the bank statement or online bank confirmation in addition to the vendor form if the first payment exceeds £25,000. Please note this in supplier record.

Simon — once you upload the VAT cert and Companies House extract we will provision the supplier record and issue PO PO-78910. Expect PO within 48 business hours after verification.
